summary: CI smoke (run by .github/workflows/ci.yml on ubuntu + windows, not by npm test) for the embedder's native optional deps without the 175 MB model: imports onnxruntime-node and tokenizers (fails with platform/arch/node in the message), checks runtimeAvailable(), fetches ONLY tokenizer.json + tokenizer_config.json through embed-model's ensureModel (pinned REVISION, sha-checked) into COLDSTART_MODEL_DIR, then plans 6 cases with loadTokenizer (every role, unicode/emoji/CRLF, a truncated code_query, a 3-window note_doc) and compares token counts/window counts ('shape') and a sha256 of all id rows to GOLDEN values. The golden ids were generated on macOS arm64 and checked identical to the old JS @huggingface/tokenizers ids (6/6), i.e. the ids the stored vectors were embedded from. `--print` prints fresh golden values; regenerate them only when tokenizer.json's REVISION or the plan logic changes on purpose.
